purpose: Add a CNY 200,000 board-lot, fee, slippage, exposure, and turnover-capacity gate to every future three-session factor diagnostic without rerunning the rejected historical frontier.

effective_scope.applies_to: Every factor diagnostic newly executed after this policy is implemented.

portfolio.target_budget_reference: Portfolio equity marked at the preceding local close; the initial capital is used for the first cohort.

market_rules.broker_commission_source: User-provided all-in broker quote of CNY 1 per CNY 10,000 with no assumed CNY 5 minimum.

price_and_corporate_action_policy.actual_price: point-in-time adjusted OHLC divided by the same-row positive restoration factor
price_and_corporate_action_policy.entry_actual_price: raw entry open multiplied by one plus the scenario adverse slippage rate
price_and_corporate_action_policy.exit_actual_price: raw eligible close multiplied by one minus the scenario adverse slippage rate
price_and_corporate_action_policy.entry_quantity: Largest nonnegative multiple of 100 shares whose actual buy notional plus fees fits the fixed slot budget, available cash, and entry gross-cap headroom.
price_and_corporate_action_policy.economic_units: entry raw share quantity divided by the entry restoration factor
price_and_corporate_action_policy.mark_value: economic units multiplied by the point-in-time adjusted close
price_and_corporate_action_policy.exit_quantity: economic units multiplied by the exit restoration factor; sell the whole position so a corporate-action odd lot is not stranded.

execution_policy.selection_and_queue_rules: Exactly reuse the bound prospective research execution policy, including signal-close fixed Top3, no substitution, positive-volume rules, conservative one-price queue handling, and the twenty-session exit-delay cap.
execution_policy.entry_capital_order: Process registered slots by factor rank, then instrument ascending; each slot keeps its own five-percent target and cannot receive another slot's unused cash.
execution_policy.capital_unavailable: Skip that slot and retain cash; do not borrow, resize an existing position, or replace the name.
execution_policy.daily_amount_use: Use same-session source amount only after the fixed order outcome to audit capacity; never use it to change the signal ranking or substitute another stock.

slippage_sensitivity.interpretation: Ten basis points adverse on entry and ten basis points adverse on exit is the fixed pilot gate; zero, five, and twenty basis points are descriptive sensitivities only.

capacity_policy.filled_trade_participation: actual adverse-price trade notional divided by same-session source amount
